.scratch/ssr-full-resolution-png-stats.p.source:
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tools/checks").resolve()))
from check_metalfx_accumulation import read_png_rgba8
from check_ssr_reflected_flicker import REGIONS
result = []
for arg in sys.argv[1:]:
    run = Path(arg)
    report = json.loads((run / "report.json").read_text())
    rows = [r for r in report["captures"] if r["channel"] == "final_color"]
    assert report["status"] == "pass"
    assert [r["checkpoint_frame"] for r in rows] == [0, 1, 4, 8]
    assert all((r["width"], r["height"]) == (1784, 1093) for r in rows)
    frames = [read_png_rgba8(run / r["data_path"], r["width"], r["height"]) for r in rows]
    regions = {}
    for name, (x0, y0, x1, y1) in REGIONS.items():
        total = mean = peak = gt8 = 0
        count = (x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0)
        for y in range(y0, y1):
            for x in range(x0, x1):
                i = 4 * (y * 1784 + x)
                delta = max(max(f[i + k] for f in frames) - min(f[i + k] for f in frames) for k in range(3))
                total += delta
                peak = max(peak, delta)
                gt8 += delta > 8
                mean += sum(max(f[i:i + 3]) for f in frames) / len(frames)
        regions[name] = {"mean_max_rgb_code_range": total / count,
                         "mean_max_rgb_code": mean / count,
                         "max_code_range": peak, "pixels_gt8_codes": gt8}
    result.append({"run": str(run), "regions": regions})
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
